reviews.body:
Thanks. Recording `system` and `tools` on the non-streaming path, and the missing `{prefix}` fix, both look right.

One masking gap: `_validate_invocation_parameter` in `utils/anthropic/_attributes.py` (not in this diff) still leaves `system` and `tools` in `llm.invocation_parameters`. `hide_inputs`, `hide_input_messages` and `hide_input_text` don't mask that attribute. I ran a stubbed `invoke_model` with `TraceConfig(hide_inputs=True)`: `llm.input_messages.*` and `input.value` were masked, but `llm.invocation_parameters` still contained `"system": [{"text": "SECRET-SYS"}]`. The streaming path and the Anthropic instrumentor already drop these keys.

```diff
--- a/python/instrumentation/openinference-instrumentation-bedrock/src/openinference/instrumentation/bedrock/utils/anthropic/_attributes.py
+++ b/python/instrumentation/openinference-instrumentation-bedrock/src/openinference/instrumentation/bedrock/utils/anthropic/_attributes.py
@@ -257,6 +257,9 @@ def _validate_invocation_parameter(parameter: Any) -> bool:
     excluded_params = (
         "messages",
         "modelId",
+        # recorded as llm.input_messages / llm.tools, where TraceConfig masking applies
+        "system",
+        "tools",
     )
     return parameter not in excluded_params
```

With this change and the test assertion suggested inline, `tox -e py314-ci-bedrock` passes: 154 tests, plus ruff and mypy.

Heads-up: #3950 makes the same `{prefix}` change and adds `"system"` to the same tuple, so whichever PR lands second will have a small conflict there.

### Maintainer's note

I pushed these changes to this branch.
- **Rebased onto `main`** (force-push from `d0d393e0`). #3950 merged changes to the same Anthropic request-attribute code, so this PR conflicted with `main`. The conflict was resolved by keeping #3950's system-prompt message shape and adding this PR's `llm.tools` and invocation-parameter changes on top.
- **`2e63810a` test(bedrock): align #3950's system-prompt tests with the unified request attributes.** After the rebase, both request paths drop `anthropic_version` from `llm.invocation_parameters`, set `llm.provider` and `llm.system`, and record a string system prompt as a text content block. #3950's tests and this PR's string-prompt test expected the older values and failed, so they now assert the new ones.
- **`854aa91a` test(bedrock): drop tests the cross-path parity test covers; assert every stream attribute.** `test_request_attributes_agree_across_paths` already covers what `test_invoke_model_records_system_prompt_and_tools` and `test_streaming_request_records_system_text_blocks_under_input_messages` checked, so those two were removed. `test_stream_final_model_name` now asserts every attribute on the span, so an unexpected attribute fails it.
